nodes.name: When clicking Execute
nodes.notes: One-off loader. Run once, then delete this workflow. No LLM calls, nothing chargeable.

nodes.name: Create eval_dataset
nodes.notes: case_id, not id: id/createdAt/updatedAt are n8n data table system columns and createDataTable throws DataTableSystemColumnNameConflictError on them. Every column is String on purpose -- expected_answer holds both numbers and text, and as_of_date must come back out as the literal 2026-09-13 the tools expect. Reuse Existing Tables is on, so re-running is harmless.

nodes.name: Read dataset.csv
nodes.notes:
Put the file there first, from the repo root:
  docker compose cp evals/dataset.csv n8n:/tmp/eval_dataset.csv
Alternative with no copy: ./n8n is already mounted read-only at /workflows, so `cp evals/dataset.csv n8n/dataset.csv` on the host makes it readable at /workflows/dataset.csv -- change the selector to that if you prefer. Read-only is enough; nothing here writes.

nodes.name: Parse CSV
nodes.notes: Header row becomes field names: id, bucket, question, as_of_date, expected_tool, expected_answer, rubric_notes. 30 items out.

nodes.name: Shape rows
nodes.notes: Emits exactly the seven data table columns. Any extra field would be rejected by insertRows validation, so the whitelist is the point.

nodes.name: Insert rows
nodes.notes: Referenced By Name so the export carries no instance-specific id. Runs once per input item: expect 30 output items. Re-running this workflow appends another 30 -- clear the table first (Data table -> ... -> Clear) if you need a redo.
